description: Compute year-over-year (YoY) monthly revenue growth for 2025. For every month listed in calendar_months with month_start in 2025, output the revenue of that month (0 if there were no completed orders), the revenue of the same month in 2024 (0 if none), and yoy_pct = 100 * (revenue - prev_year_revenue) / prev_year_revenue, which must be NULL when prev_year_revenue is 0. Only orders with status = 'completed' count. Output columns: month (DATE), revenue (FLOAT64), prev_year_revenue (FLOAT64), yoy_pct (FLOAT64, 1 decimal).

month_start.description: First day of the month; one row per month, no gaps

edge_cases: Month with no revenue in the current year must still appear with revenue 0
Month with no revenue in the prior year yields yoy_pct NULL (no division by zero)
Cancelled orders are excluded in both years
common_failure_modes: FM2: LAG(revenue, 12) over months present in the data compares against the wrong month when months are missing
FM1: INNER JOIN between current-year and prior-year aggregates drops months missing from either side
FM7: Missing SAFE_DIVIDE / NULLIF causes a division-by-zero error
